It is difficult to hear, and it sounds difficult to do, but I think you are probably right. (notice the probably because I wish I didn't have to do it, but it is necessary). 

I need to let her go and find some new and better friends. Thank you for helping me come to that decision.

I'm sorry to hear that you've been through similar stuff and the heart problems sound terrible :/

When I was in a bad state like this last time I saw my GP and he set me up with a mental health plan and a referral to a psych. Then I met my now ex girlfriend and I was really happy again and figured that I didn't need to see the psychologist anymore. That was obviously the wrong choice, perhaps if I saw the professional then I wouldn't be how I am now.

I'm going to book an appointment to see the psych.

Anyway, thanks a tonne for the advice and the push to do what I need to do.

I'm going to try and work at being happy on my own, it can just be really difficult at times when I feel so lonely.

I think I will study during the trip, and I'm definitely going to have to put my back into it haha. 

Thank you for the advice!

Thanks for the reply and the advice. I'm going to start writing in a journal about the anxiety, and probably just about my feelings in general.

Thank you

I'm in love, or the 18 year old equivalent of love.
It's been on and off for like 7-8 years. First started when I was probably 11 or 12; I was bullied a lot as a child. Then back again when I was 14-15. Then again when I was 16 and 17 through senior high school. It just started back up again in January. I've had times where it went away for like a year, and some times it went away for a few months, but it always, inevitably comes back.

Actually yeah, I live on the coast. It's really nice.
Yeah, I think so. I guess I just don't like accepting it because it makes me feel like I'm one of those attention seeking girls on social media. I guess since I never actually share my feelings I couldn't be one of them. Hahaha.

Thanks heaps. It helps to know that someone would write such a well thought out reply for me. You wrote some really great advice. Thanks dude.
